notes.title: BETA-testing applications
notes.content:
I will need some BETA-testers to try out some levels and check the performance on respective computer hardware, please send a application to become a beta tester to jonathan@playdungeonrunner.com

If you have any previous BETA-tester experience, then let me know! (It's a huge plus)

Q&A

Q: How many testers are you looking for?
A: Not sure yet, maybe around 10-20 people.

Q: How do we get the BETA-game?
A: I will send you a BETA-key for the game on steam for you to try it out with.

Q: What should I include in my application-email?
A: You should link your steam-profile, the important computer specs and a motivation to why I should choose you! If you have any previous experience with beta-testing then please let me know that, aswell.

Q: Is there any reward for BETA-testing the game?
A: I will not pay or anything like that. BETA-testing is a volunteers job. Though it might happen that BETA-testers will get a full game key when it's released
